summary: PowerShell module itself follows best practices (error handling, parameter validation, module exports) and YAML uses pinned actions/correct shell mode. CRITICAL GAPS: test files completely missing (task explicitly requires red/green TDD with Pester, 'start by writing your first failing test'); no test harness to run `act` and capture output to required `act-result.txt` artifact; fixture files (.json, .txt) not provided; workflow doesn't validate exact output values or assert 'Job succeeded'. Workflow runs basic Pester check but omits end-to-end act integration (for each test case: setup repo + fixture, run `act push --rm`, parse & verify output). Workflow validation tests absent. Deliverable is ~60% code, ~0% test/verification layer.
